description.value: The 4 Mile Restaurant & Brewpub is a full-service pub and craft brewery on the Island Highway in View Royal, Victoria, producing a year-round and seasonal lineup of house-brewed beers alongside a broad food menu of shareables, mains, and weekend brunch. The venue also houses a dedicated sports bar ('4 Below Sports Bar') and offers High Tea, giving it an unusually wide range of experiences under one roof. Cyclists travelling the Island Highway corridor would find it a substantial mid-route or end-of-day stop with local craft beer brewed on the premises.
